title: Fresh Guarded Start Lifecycle Canary Paused
summary: Record that the FP-MCP-241 fresh lifecycle canary was prepared but intentionally not started because pre-start evidence validation was incomplete. Request artifact, structured approval, and popup local clearance were created successfully, but the pre-start evidence validator reported missing pre-start evidence artifact and request-artifact-hash evidence. The runner start endpoint was not contacted and OpenCode was not started. This is a disciplined pause, not a failed execution.
caveats: The FP-MCP-241 approval and local clearance may expire while the recording path is repaired; expired artifacts must not be reused for a later start.
No attempt should be made to start the runner until preStartEvidenceComplete and preStartEvidenceValid are both true for a fresh tuple.
Approval consumption was not attempted because no start occurred.
The correct pre-start evidence recorder call with approval id was blocked by the wrapper, so FP-MCP-242 should repair or provide a usable MCP-layer path for this non-executing evidence artifact.
